    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    p = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

    visited = [False] * n
    q = [0] * n

    for i in range(n):
        if not visited[i]:
            cycle = []
            x = i
            while not visited[x]:
                visited[x] = True
                cycle.append(x)
                x = p[x] - 1

            m = len(cycle)
            if m % 2 == 1:
                print(-1)
                return

            for j in range(m // 2):
                q[cycle[j]] = cycle[j + m // 2] + 1
                q[cycle[j + m // 2]] = cycle[j] + 1

    print(' '.join(map(str, q)))
